A service costs $18.00 for each month you use it, or $131.00 for a nonrefundable annual pass. Monthly service can be canceled without a fee. Ignoring interest, what is the smallest whole number of paid months at which the annual pass costs strictly less?
explanation: The annual pass is cheaper when months × $18.00 > $131.00. The threshold is $131.00 ÷ $18.00 = 7.278 months, so the first whole number above it is 8.
